title: Venezuelan Smoked Sushi
description: A unique fusion dish combining the bold flavors of Venezuela with the delicate taste of sushi. This recipe is perfect for adventurous foodies who want to try something new.

ingredients.name: veggie sushi rice
ingredients.notes: use a short-grain rice for the best results

ingredients.name: zesty plant-based sauce
ingredients.notes: adjust the level of heat to your liking

ingredients.name: smoked egg
ingredients.notes: smoke the eggs over low heat for 30 minutes for the best flavor

ingredients.name: plant-based filling
ingredients.notes: use a mixture of sautéed vegetables and vegan mayo

ingredients.name: sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice crunch

instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the smoked eggs into small pieces and set aside.
Assemble the sushi rolls by spreading a thin layer of zesty plant-based sauce on each nori sheet.
Add a small amount of sushi rice to the center of each sheet, leaving a small border at the top.
Add a few pieces of smoked egg and some plant-based filling to the rice.
Roll up the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat or your hands.
Slice the rolls into individual pieces and serve with sesame seeds on top, if desired.
Adjust the seasoning and serve immediately.
